title: Calibration — the starting position
instructions: Set board A up for the start of a game, home boards to the RIGHT for both players.

Sit where the checklist says (the side where WHITE bears off into the tray on your right) and prop the phone so the whole playing field, both bear-off trays included, is inside the picture: propped at the end of the table, roughly a hand span above it.
Nothing on the felt but the checkers — no dice, no cube, no hands.
Take the photo. DO NOT MOVE THE PHONE OR THE BOARD until this session's shots are all taken.
